orientation_note: Camera views the machine's right flank. Established via cross-reference: page009 (front-right 3/4) shows the crank prominently while page007 (back-right 3/4) does not, so the crank/pinion-sprocket assembly sits at the machine's front-right corner. Given the standard 8-view rotation order (front, front-left, left, back-left, back, back-right, right, front-right), the crank appearing in the RIGHT portion of this right-side image is consistent with: within this image, the RIGHT side of the frame = the machine's FRONT (platen/paper side), and the LEFT side of the frame = the machine's BACK. Only the near (machine-right) flank of the base slab and top frame casting is visible; the far (machine-left) flank corners are occluded.
